Problem: Write a function to get a lucid number smaller than or equal to n.

Tests:
assert get_ludic(10) == [1, 2, 3, 5, 7]
assert get_ludic(25) == [1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 23, 25]
assert get_ludic(45) == [1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 23, 25, 29, 37, 41, 43]

Write the t task named `get_ludic` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) int, in the order the tests pass them, returning seq. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
